description: This file appears to be a shell script used for testing and managing git partial clone features, including functions for manipulating objects, performing fetches, and testing various scenarios related to partial clone functionality in a Git environment.

methods.name: delete_object
methods.description: Removes a specific object from a repository directory based on the hash.

methods.name: pack_as_from_promisor
methods.description: Creates and outputs a packfile from a promisor remote, returning the pack's hash.

methods.name: promise_and_delete
methods.description: Tags an object with an annotated tag, promisor packs it, and then deletes the original object from the repository.

methods.name: repack_and_check
methods.description: Repackages repositories and checks the existence of specific objects post-repack, optionally expecting failure.
